item.title: New Team Xray XB8/XT8 Stainless Steel Skid Plates
item.description: Team Xray has released new front and rear skid plates for the XB8/XT8 for both nitro and electric chassis.

item.title: New Ruddog RPS Power Supply
item.description: The RUDDOG RPS Power Supply delivers up to 750W at 12V and provides a continuous current of up to 62.5A, giving modern multi channel chargers and high power pit setups a stable and reliable energy source.

item.title: New ProTek RC Traction Compound Applicator
item.description: Take control of your tire prep with the ProTek RC Traction Compound Bottle. This 2-pack of 40ml bottles makes applying liquid tire sauce clean, precise, and hassle-free.

item.title: Amain Hobbies Announced as Executive JConcepts North American Distributor
item.description: AMain Hobbies is pleased to announce an exclusive North American distribution agreement with JConcepts, an iconic and industry-leading brand synonymous with producing some of the finest radio-controlled accessories for the past 20-plus years.

item.title: New Revolution Design HD B7 C-Blocks
item.description: Revolution Design's HD Suspension Mount C for Team Associated's latest T7 and SC7 trucks, as well as updated B7 buggies equipped with the new 3-gear transmission, is a must-have upgrade for racers looking for enhanced durability and tuning options.

item.title: Avid RC Carpet Tires Teaser
item.description: Avid Racing Concepts debuted their prototype carpet tires at the 2025 US Carpet Off-Road Championships, check out some teaser photos from the Scotty Ernst Productions crew.

item.title: New Schumacher CAT 2000 "Classic" Release
item.description: The CAT 2000 was Schumacher’s groundbreaking 4WD buggy introduced in 1993, evolving from the legendary CAT series that included the Bosscat and ProCat.

item.title: Takahata Now 2-Time World Champion
item.description: Shoki Takahata is now a 2-Time World Champion after taking the win this past weekend at the 2025 IFMAR World Championships for 1/8th Scale On-Road held in Chile. Takahata would take the win just under a lap ahead of Simon Kurzbuch and TQ man Andrea C

item.title: Hudy Arena to Host 2027 IFMAR 1/10th Off-Road World Championships
item.description: Important announcement regarding the 2027 IFMAR Electric Off-Road Buggy World Championships. Hudy Arena will host the event in 2027.

item.title: New SMJ Racing RS Series Lefty 1/8th GP Springs
item.description: The long-awaited RS series has been added to the lineup of the standard “SMJ Stealth Line Lefty Springs” for 1/8 GP racing car shock absorbers.
